bagPolicy.summary: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC totes up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches are accepted. The FAQ gives conflicting clutch limits of 6.5 × 9 inches and 4.5 × 6.5 inches; use a clutch no larger than 4.5 × 6.5 inches to satisfy both published limits.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Stubb’s has no parking lot. Public metered spaces and paid garages nearby are limited.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Rideshare drop-off and pickup are at Ninth and Red River Streets, rather than directly in front of the amphitheater gate.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food is sold at the amphitheater stand and in the restaurant. Outside food and drinks are prohibited, and the venue accepts major cards rather than cash or checks.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The venue is standing room only and does not allow personal chairs. Email its ADA assistance supervisor ahead of time to arrange a chair or other accommodation for a medical need.
prohibited: Personal chairs without a medical accommodation
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Guests under 21 cannot re-enter. Those 21 or older may re-enter with a valid ticket stub and venue-issued wristband, and must pass security screening again.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Collect outdoor-show tickets at the box office just outside the amphitheater on Red River Street. Mobile ticket barcodes are also accepted on phones; the box office does not sell tickets.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Standard doors open at 7 p.m., but times vary by show; check the ticket or event listing. Outdoor arrivals undergo bag checks and handheld metal-detector screening.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
